name: What preparations do I need to make before countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your countertop installation day, please ensure all items are cleared from your existing countertops and from the base cabinets below. This includes removing small appliances, dishes, and any stored goods. For safety and efficiency, clear a path from the entry point to the kitchen. If a new sink is being installed, ensure the area beneath is accessible for plumbing connections. We recommend having your main water shut-off easily accessible to our team.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear all items from existing countertops and base cabinets, and ensure a clear path to the kitchen. Ensure the area under the sink is accessible and main water shut-off is available.
